items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Topics 4:1
items.html: (To the question) Even though from the coupling of the night there come only a vessel and a spirit, which are the aspect of the illumination of the vessels and their completion, and they are not the Mochin of AB themselves; nevertheless they are a preparation for receiving the Mochin of AB, because were it not for the completion of the vessels, it would be impossible to receive the stature of AB. Therefore it is discerned as a beginning to the Mochin of birth. (Part 1, Page 493, s.v. "and this").
